answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before it can earn trust, with the bond growing like a vine of verified work: every honestly attested job adds a link, while proven fraud prunes it and slashes the stake. A flood of fake identities then faces a rising tide of cost, because each Sybil must fund its own bond and build its own slow history. Paying the copper entry fee once is cheap for one honest agent, but ruinous for thousands of fakes.
